title: Network-based identification of miRNAs and transcription factors and in silico drug screening targeting delta-secretase involved in Alzheimer's disease.
authors: Iqbal, Saleem; Malik, Md Zubbair; Pal, Debnath
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络分析识别阿尔茨海默病中delta-secretase相关miRNA和转录因子，并进行药物筛选与分子动力学模拟，但核心对象是蛋白酶-小分子互作，TF-DNA仅作为调控网络提及，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模与互作机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: System medicine approaches have played a pivotal role in identifying novel disease networks especially in miRNA research. It is no wonder that miRNAs are implicated in multiple clinical conditions, allowing us to establish the hubs and nodes for network models of Alzheimer's Disease (AD). AD is an age-related, progressive, irreversible, and multifactorial neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive and memory impairment and is the most common cause of dementia in older adults. Worldwide, around 50 million people have dementia, and there are nearly 10 million new cases every year. delta-secretase, also known as asparagine endopeptidase (AEP) or legumain (LGMN), is a lysosomal cysteine protease that cleaves peptide bonds C-terminally to asparagine residues in both amyloid precursor protein (APP) and tau, mediating the amyloid-beta and tau pathology in AD. The patient's miRNA expression was found to be deregulated in the brain, extracellular fluid, blood plasma, and serum. METHODS: Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) networks of LGMN or delta-secretase were constructed using the Genemania database. Network Analyzer, a Cytoscape plugin, analyzed the network topological properties of LGMN. miRNAs related to Alzheimer's were extracted from the HMDD (Human microRNA Disease Database) and experimentally verified miRNA-gene interaction was obtained by searching miRWalk. Starbase v2.0 and miRanda were used for screening miRNA of LGMN genes. Moreover, to understand the regulatory mechanism in AD, we have screened major transcription factors of LGMN targeted genes using the Network Analyst 3.0, TRRUST (v2.0) server, and ENCODE. The Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) and BEST tool were used to investigate the expression pattern of the LGMN gene. In parallel, we performed in-silico drug designing of the novel inhibitor scaffold of delta-secretase as powerful therapeutic targets by using the concept of scaffolds and frameworks. In this context, this study also aimed at identifying effective small molecule inhibitors targeting delta-secretase. RESULTS: Among the 16 experimentally verified miRNAs, Network analysis of the LGMN and its associated miRNA identify novel hsa-miRNA-106a-5p and hsa-miRNA-34a-5p being more expressed in the brain. Our in silico high throughput screening, followed by XP docking revealed Oprea1 as the lead. Molecular dynamic simulations of the delta-secretase-docked complex have been carried out for a time period of 200 ns and revealed that Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD) of the protein Calpha-backbone with respect to its starting position increased to 1.20 A for the first 25 ns of the trajectory and then became stable around 0.6 A in the last 170 ns course of the simulation. The radius of gyration (RGYR) reveals that compactness was maintained till the end of simulations. CONCLUSION: Network analysis of LGMN associated miRNAs lead to the identification of two novel miRNAs, being highly expressed in the brain. This study also lead to the identification and expression of 10 Transcription factors associated with LGMN. Expression Heatmap results show high and continuous expression of LGMN in most of the regions of the brain, especially in the frontal cortex. Further, in silico drug analysis led us to the identification of Oprea1 which could be taken for further investigation to explore its potential for AD therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：系统医学方法在识别新型疾病网络方面发挥了关键作用，尤其是在miRNA研究中。毫无疑问，miRNAs与多种临床状况相关，使我们能够为阿尔茨海默病（AD）建立网络模型的枢纽和节点。AD是一种与年龄相关、进行性、不可逆且多因素的神经退行性疾病，其特征是认知和记忆障碍，并且是老年人痴呆的最常见原因。全球约有5000万人患有痴呆症，每年新增近1000万例。δ-分泌酶，也称为天冬酰胺内肽酶（AEP）或legumain（LGMN），是一种溶酶体半胱氨酸蛋白酶，在淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）和tau蛋白的天冬酰胺残基C端切割肽键，介导AD中的淀粉样蛋白-β和tau病理。患者的miRNA表达在脑、细胞外液、血浆和血清中被发现失调。方法：使用Genemania数据库构建了LGMN或δ-分泌酶的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。Network Analyzer（Cytoscape插件）分析了LGMN的网络拓扑特性。与阿尔茨海默病相关的miRNAs从HMDD（人类microRNA疾病数据库）中提取，并通过搜索miRWalk获得实验验证的miRNA-基因相互作用。使用Starbase v2.0和miRanda筛选LGMN基因的miRNAs。此外，为了理解AD中的调控机制，我们使用Network Analyst 3.0、TRRUST（v2.0）服务器和ENCODE筛选了LGMN靶基因的主要转录因子。使用基因型-组织表达（GTEx）和BEST工具研究LGMN基因的表达模式。同时，我们利用支架和框架的概念，对δ-分泌酶的新型抑制剂支架进行了计算机模拟药物设计，作为强大的治疗靶点。在此背景下，本研究还旨在识别靶向δ-分泌酶的有效小分子抑制剂。结果：在16个实验验证的miRNAs中，LGMN及其相关miRNA的网络分析识别出新的hsa-miRNA-106a-5p和hsa-miRNA-34a-5p在脑中表达更高。我们的计算机模拟高通量筛选，随后进行XP对接，揭示Oprea1为先导化合物。对δ-分泌酶对接复合物进行了200 ns的分子动力学模拟，结果显示蛋白质Cα-骨架相对于其起始位置的均方根偏差（RMSD）在轨迹的前25 ns内增加到1.20 Å，然后在模拟的最后170 ns内稳定在约0.6 Å。回转半径（RGYR）表明，紧凑性一直保持到模拟结束。结论：LGMN相关miRNAs的网络分析导致识别出两个在脑中高表达的新型miRNAs。本研究还识别并表达了与LGMN相关的10个转录因子。表达热图结果显示，LGMN在脑的大部分区域，尤其是额叶皮层，表现出高且持续的表达。此外，计算机模拟药物分析使我们识别出Oprea1，可进一步研究以探索其在AD治疗中的潜力。
